claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two direct helpers left opaque by FACT-0030 are closed as exact independent bodies. Player.SetStunTime (0x06004EDA) has one Int32 parameter named tm and an exact 27-byte body: it stores StunTime=tm, compares the stored value against zero with the emitted signed bge branch, clamps negative values to zero, then returns. MatchMisc.GetParamRate (0x06004975) has one Float32 parameter named prm, returns Float32, and has an exact 16-byte body: it computes (prm / 65535.0f) * 100.0f, stores the result in its local and returns it. FACT-0030 pins CalcDownTime calls to SetStunTime and two GetParamRate calls using HP and SP.
